- **`_kl_post_response_slot` slot semantic (UNCHANGED in this round).** The function uses `pos = input_ids.shape[1] - 1` — under Qwen-2.5-7B's chat template applied to `[{"role": "user", "content": question}, {"role": "assistant", "content": completion}]` with `add_generation_prompt=False`, that index points at the LAST template token (typically the closing `<|im_end|>` after the assistant's response). `.claude/rules/marker-leakage-measurement.md`'s "post-response slot" definition is "last token of R BEFORE + EOS" — i.e. the slot at which the model emits EOS. If the chat template's closing tokens are NOT what's intended, the KL DV is being computed at a different position than the marker-leakage rule mandates. The analyzer should: (i) tokenize a sample question+completion under the actual Qwen-2.5-7B chat template and read the last 5 token ids vs `tokenizer.added_tokens_decoder`, (ii) confirm whether the intended slot is the assistant-content-end (right after the last completion token) or the template-end (right after `<|im_end|>`). - **`_score_b1_openai_gpt4o` OpenAI client error handling** — the function catches any `Exception` from `client.chat.completions.create` and writes an `api_error` sentinel.
